titles.romaji: Maou Evelogia ni Mi wo Sasageyo
titles.native: 魔王イブロギアに身を捧げよ

description:
The story begins when an aimless young man named Toshiaki Gozu is killed, and resurrected as a background character in a game world he has been playing. Gozu encounters the Demon King Evelogia, the game's last boss whom Gozu has adored since he was little. Gozu begins to woo Evelogia by admitting, "I fell in love with you." Together, they aim to conquer the world.

Note: The complete edition was distributed web via Comic Festa Anime Zone. The censored version was broadcasted on Tokyo MX and BS11.
